id1.description: Anticipatory decisions about possible treatments or activities, usually asserted by an authorised clinician.

id3.description: Description of the overall intent for future care and treatment for the individual.

id4.description: Narrative description about the logic and justification for the 'Intent of care' statement.

id5.description: Directive for future cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) intervention.

at6.description: All appropriate cardiopulmonary resuscitation treatments should be attempted to save or prolong life.

at7.description: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation treatments should be attempted, as specified in the 'Description' narrative or as structured data in the 'Per intervention' cluster.

at8.description: No cardiopulmonary resuscitation treatments should be attempted to save or prolong life. All treatments to be focused on symptom relief and quality of life. Also known as 'Do not resuscitate (DNR)'; 'Do not attempt resuscitation (DNAR)'; 'Not for resuscitation (NFR)' or similar.

at9.description: The CPR decision is not known.

id10.description: Narrative description of the advance intervention decisions.

id11.description: Details of the decision about possible treatments or activities that may be life-saving, life-prolonging or cause undesirable side effects.

id12.description: Name of the possible treatment or activity.

at13.description: Placement of a tube into the trachea to maintain an open airway, including a tracheostomy.

at14.description: Artificial ventilation where invasive means are used to assist or replace spontaneous breathing.

at15.description: Artificial ventilation where non-invasive means are used to assist or replace spontaneous breathing.

at16.description: Medication that supports heart function, including but not limited to: vasopressors, inotropes and chronotropes.

at17.description: Process of removing excess water, solutes, and toxins from the blood.

at18.description: Therapeutic substance prepared from human blood including, but not limited to: whole blood; blood components; and plasma derivatives.

at20.description: Provision of nutrients by means other than eating or drinking.

at21.description: Transfer and admission to an intensive care or high dependency unit.

at22.description: Transfer to hospital for assessment or admission.

at23.description: Maintenance of hydration by means other than eating or drinking.

at24.description: Insertion of a peripheral intravenous line.

at27.description: The intervention is recommended only in specific circumstances, captured using the 'Conditions' data element.

at29.description: The intervention decision is not known.

id30.description: Narrative description of the circumstances in which a Conditional recommendation is applicable.

id31.description: Additional narrative about the intervention decision, not captured in other fields.

id32.description: Additional structured details about advance intervention decisions.

id33.description: Narrative description about awareness of the Advance intervention decisions by the individual.

id34.description: Narrative description about awareness of the Advance intervention decisions by family, carers or legal proxy.

id35.description: Digital document, image or video representing these Advance intervention decisions.

id36.description: Additional narrative about all advance intervention decisions, not captured in other fields.

id38.description: The date and/or time when the Advance intervention decisions were last updated.

id39.description: The date/time that marks the beginning of the valid period of time for the Advance intervention decisions.

id40.description: The date/time that marks the conclusion of the valid period of time for the Advance intervention decisions.

id41.description: The date when review of the Advance intervention decisions are due.

id42.description: Description of any legislation or other authoritative guidance that apply.

id43.description: Information about the physical or digital location of the advance intervention decisions record.

id44.description: Physical or digital location of the Advance intervention decisions record.

id45.description: Details of a person who has a copy of the Advance intervention decisions record.

id46.description: Additional information required to extend the model with local content or to align with other reference models or formalisms.

at47.description: Use of electric shock to reset the electrical state of the heart.

at48.description: Insertion of a needle into the pleural or pericardial space.

at49.description: Insertion of a tube into the pleural space.

at50.text: Central venous line or any arterial line
at50.description: Insertion of a central venous line or any arterial line.

at51.description: Technique used to manually pump blood around the body during a cardiac arrest.

at52.description: Insertion of an artificial pacemaker to control the heart beat.

at53.description: Medications used during an emergency resuscitation to prolong life. For example: adrenaline, atropine, sodium bicarbonate, calcium, other vasoactive medications.

ac1.description: Directive for future cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) intervention. (synthesised)

ac2.description: Name of the possible treatment or activity. (synthesised)
